video_title: Isiah Thomas on Wemby Living Up to SKY HIGH Expectations?!?

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas names Jalen Brunson as the most consistent Knicks player
quotes.excerpt: He's been the most consistent best player on both teams.
quotes.quote: You have to say OG is the pick. He's been the most consistent best player on both teams. And when I say consistent, when you look at what he's shooting, how he's playing, what he's doing when he's out on the floor, he's been the man. I would go Brunson after that, and then, if we're talking Knicks, I'm going OG, Brunson, Cat.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas defends Jalen Brunson's performance against analytics-based criticism
quotes.excerpt: This is where the analytics get you all screwed up.
quotes.quote: This is where the analytics get you all screwed up. Oh, well, he's only shooting 33% from the field and he's got 23. And then you go to the other column and you say, damn, the little fella averaging 29 points in this series. He's averaging 28 or 29. He just dropped 35 and I think before that he was averaging 27. But you're going to talk to me about, well, he's only shooting 32% from the field.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas highlights Jalen Brunson's ability to score despite defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: Every defensive possession they're trying to stop Brunson from scoring.
quotes.quote: Every defensive possession they're trying to stop Brunson from scoring, and he's getting off at his size, doing it left hand, right hand, three-point shot, giving you everything you want. But yet you're talking about, well, he's only shooting 32%. And then you go to that other column and he's averaging 29.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas compares his and Jalen Brunson's playstyle to Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: Curry did it at 6'3 more or less shooting, scoring. Brunson and I, if Brunson becomes a champion, we did it scoring and assisting.
quotes.quote: I want to be 6'3, so I'm going to say 6'3 and under. And here's where it separates. Curry did it at 6'3 more or less shooting, scoring. Brunson and I, if Brunson becomes a champion, we did it scoring and assisting. And I take Magic and I put him in the freak category at 6'9 because that, and then he had Kareem, so okay. But Brunson and I, scoring and assisting, that is something totally different.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas compares Victor Wembanyama's potential to Michael Jordan and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: We jumped the gun when Kareem was dominating the league and then MJ came along and he became the face of the league.
quotes.quote: We jumped the gun when Kareem was dominating the league and then MJ came along and he hadn't won a championship yet, but he became the face of the league and we saw the potential in him. Jordan had a chance to be something different than any of us, so we saw that, hey man, he could possibly be the best one to ever do this. And then LeBron James came along and all of y'all knew like LeBron, he was on a different level than y'all, so he became the face. And then now with Wemby coming, you're looking at Wemby and you're saying, he ain't like no other big man we've ever seen.

quotes.speaker: Isiah Thomas
quotes.summary_phrase: Isiah Thomas claims players are jealous of LeBron James's legacy
quotes.excerpt: I'm calling it out, guys are jealous, they get envious.
quotes.quote: I'm calling it out, guys are jealous, they get envious. You bring them on the show, then they want to talk about what they did or what somebody else did, and then they intentionally ignore the obvious. And when you intentionally ignore the obvious, then that has to come back to some jealousy or envy or just some straight-up BS. Now this man got every basketball record on the books and he ain't in your top five, you full of shit.
